title: Check the caller contract and owner lifetime before repairing a helper
applies_when: An isolated reproduction alleges a missing method decorator, script global, cache-key collision, or stale object identity, but omits the interface or owner that invokes the helper.
lesson: Read the declared interface, actual invocation, and surrounding ownership before choosing a regression. A Python receiver named cls is still an instance receiver unless the method has a classmethod descriptor. An id-keyed cache can have an apparent reuse hazard that an outer strong reference rules out for the reviewed call sequence; follow creation, replacement and invalidation together. A script can initialize a module global inside its __main__ block before invoking a helper; a truncated excerpt or import-only test omits that supported entry. Fetch the missing tail before repairing its environment. Test the supported entry and an independent normal control rather than inventing a class-only call or dropping references the real owner retains. These source counterexamples change which evidence to acquire next; they do not automatically reject a new hypothesis.
avoid_when: A documented standalone/public helper contract can be violated even if internal callers do not exercise that input. Absence of a shipped caller does not disprove an API defect. Strong references prevent identity reuse only for their actual lifetime; they do not prevent mutation, stale metadata, concurrency bugs, or defects after a new caller changes ownership. The cited revisions are source/interface counterexamples, not package, accelerator, or general false-positive-rate measurements.

evidence.note: The documented torchrun entry initializes global rank before join/update_weights call check_sglang_ready. A first-120-line excerpt misses that initialization; importing and invoking the helper alone is not this shipped execution path. Static counterexample only, not distributed execution evidence.
QuantizationConfig declares get_supported_act_dtypes as an abstract instance method, independently of the receiver's spelling in an implementation.
The production loader calls the method on quant_config. A class-only TypeError is not a reproduction of this caller's contract.

forward_extend checks the cached object's identity and retains forward_batch in the outer metadata tuple while resolving the next helper result. An isolated id-reuse test omitting that reference does not establish the alleged production failure. This is a revision-bound source observation, not NPU execution evidence.
